name: α-PVT
summary: A rare stimulant drug related to a-PVP. The drug is very uncommon. The drug is suspected to be less potent than a-PVP, however little data exists on this compound and its effects on humans. Consume with caution.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It produces stimulating effects in humans, according to the individuals who have tried it.

uses.text: α-Pyrrolidinopentiothiophenone (also known as α-PVT) is a synthetic stimulant of the cathinone and thiopropamine (thiophenylpropylamine) families that has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.text: α-PVT has been shown to possess high cytotoxicity against human cell lines.
